title: The Cosmic Game
author: Stanislav Grof
description: The Cosmic Game: Explorations of the Frontiers of Human Consciousness by Stanislav Grof (State University of New York Press, 1998), a founder of transpersonal psychology and pioneer of LSD-assisted and holotropic breathwork research. Drawing on four decades of observing non-ordinary states of consciousness in thousands of sessions, Grof distils the metaphysical worldview that emerged from his clients' experiences. He explores the nature of the creative principle (Absolute Consciousness), why it creates universes, the process of creation as a divine play (lila), the taboo against knowing who we are, good and evil, death and rebirth, reincarnation and karma, and the implications for the ecological and spiritual crisis of modern humanity. Grof shows how these insights converge with the perennial philosophy of the mystical traditions, making it a key bridge between consciousness research and esoteric metaphysics.
